ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominant high-intensity (white) pixels in central lobe regions (~75%) with low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated at the lateral tips and along the trailing edge boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation at the distal tips of both lobes. The trailing edge is marked by a continuous dark band. The central ventral surface is predominantly white with a localized cluster of dark spots on the medial-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 125 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge. The left lobe exhibits high-frequency serrations (5-10 pixel amplitude), while the right lobe contains larger, more irregular topographic voids.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced convex upward curvature originating from the median notch and terminating at the distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular excision/notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe, approximately two-thirds of the distance from the notch to the tip, indicating significant historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Severe overexposure (pixel saturation) in the central fluke regions masks fine-grained surface texture.
